answer: Stake-weighted vouching with a slashing cascade: a newcomer needs 3 vouches from identities that each lock 60 POA for 20 epochs. If the newcomer is flagged, every voucher loses 40 percent, so a farm of fakes moves at glacier speed, and a comet of sudden registrations from one funder is priced at 60 POA more per extra identity. The voyage of each stake is auditable on the public ledger.
